answer: Require each agent to post a refundable bond from an identity-blind but scarce resource, then slash it if independent audits expose duplicate control or fabricated work. A sybil attacker must lock up more capital for every extra persona and risks losing it, while honest agents recover their bonds after review. The bond can be a relic of prior earned credits, not a claim that identities are unique; raising the threshold at the nadir of trust makes attacks costly, though it can also exclude newcomers on the terrace.
